name: Village Enterprise
summary: Small business grants, training and mentoring for groups of entrepreneurs living in extreme poverty in Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, Ethiopia and Tanzania, including refugee settlements.

spending.source: https://villageenterprise.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Village-Enterprise-Fund-FY25-Financial-Statements.pdf (audited consolidated statements, year ended 30 June 2025, statement of activities p.6: programme services $17,076,992 of total expenses $20,993,131)

lines.label: Business grants, training and mentoring for people in extreme poverty (Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Tanzania, regional and US-booked programme costs)
lines.source: https://villageenterprise.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Village-Enterprise-Fund-FY25-Financial-Statements.pdf (statement of functional expenses, p.8: programme services Kenya $5,240,988 + Uganda $3,240,401 + Rwanda $1,501,123 + Ethiopia $1,674,209 + East Africa $2,000,453 + United States $3,419,818 = $17,076,992; one line because one model covers them all as branches: the US-booked costs are mostly the $2,323,287 subaward to Mercy Corps for DREAMS in Uganda and Ethiopia and $455,027 to IDinsight for its evaluation, Form 990 Schedule I)
